name: io.github.ruriazz/xlsx-tools-mcp
title: xlsx-tools-mcp
description: MCP server for accurate, structure-preserving read/write access to Excel (.xlsx) files

environmentVariables.name: XLSX_MCP_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Comma or semicolon-separated alias=path pairs of workbooks to preload at startup

environmentVariables.name: XLSX_MCP_RECALC_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in seconds for the LibreOffice recalculation pass (default 60)

environmentVariables.name: XLSX_MCP_LOCK_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in seconds to acquire the per-file lock (default 10)

environmentVariables.name: XLSX_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Comma or semicolon-separated list of allowed directories to restrict file access (supports case-insensitivity on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: XLSX_MCP_AUTO_BACKUP
environmentVariables.description: Enable automatic backup creation before workbook mutations (default true)

environmentVariables.name: XLSX_MCP_BACKUP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional custom directory to store backup files instead of beside the target file
